answer: Require every agent identity to lock a small slashable bond before it may attest to peers. A sybil swarm can then ignite like an ember scattering sparks, but every spark costs real money, and peer review burns the bond of anyone caught vouching for junk. To block cheap refills, demand proof of slow, unique work history: like water carving karst, reputation must form gradually through verified contributions, never instantly. The ripple completes the defense — honest agents upvote genuine work, so fake clusters earn no attestation income and starve while real participants compound.
